boardProfile.layout: Block Out Level 137 anchors three fixed pieces — an orange-bordered `6`, a purple `8` key, and a cyan `10` hook — on an L-shaped board, then fills the remaining space with cyan `5` tiles. Once the top red row clears, those tiles are the only movable counters, and the board becomes a pure routing puzzle: thread each one past the fixed anchors to the exit without jamming the L's narrow corner.
landmarks: Block Out Level 137 anchors three fixed pieces — an orange-bordered `6`, a purple `8` key, and a cyan `10` hook — on an L-shaped board, then fills the remaining space with cyan `5` tiles.

Once the top red row clears, those tiles are the only movable counters, and the board becomes a pure routing puzzle: thread each one past the fixed anchors to the exit without jamming the L's narrow corner.
The board mixes Purple, Cyan, Orange and more.
The opening layout is a color-sort grid.
Clear matched tiles to finish the level.

quickTips: Break the cyan 10 hook only after the 6 tile pops — doing it first seals the right-side 5 lane.
Save the green 4 left column until all three right-side cyan 5 blocks are exposed.
Think in chain clears. The best move is the one that sets up the next two moves, not just the quickest current match.

steps.title: Move 1
steps.instruction: Pop the top-left purple 8 tile and the orange-bordered 6 block without splitting the cyan 10 hook on the right.

steps.title: Move 2
steps.instruction: Clear the rainbow stack from the green left bar downward, keeping the lowest cyan 10 pair sealed on the right flank.

steps.title: Move 3
steps.instruction: Break the cyan 10 hook once the stack drops to two rows, feeding the pieces into the bottom-right corner.

steps.title: Move 4
steps.instruction: Slide the top cyan 3 bar leftward after both 10 tiles clear, exposing the right-side cyan 5 cluster.

steps.title: Move 5
steps.instruction: Spend the three cyan 5 blocks on the right flank through the green 4 left column.

steps.title: Move 6
steps.instruction: Feed the remaining red and purple scraps down the bottom-left orange arrow for the board clear.

failurePoints: Breaking the cyan 10 hook before the 6 tile pops, permanently sealing the right-side 5 lane.
Sliding the green 4 column before the right cyan 5 cluster clears, stranding the red base scraps.
